description: Sentences a read or a call takes out of a value and draws (measured: each drawn, the separators between two items): an item read off an array by its index, and read optionally, an entry off a map, a string a method of its own is called on, the separators a method of an array is handed, called and called optionally, and the argument of `$any`, which the compiler takes off as no call. A call of the class's method is the class's code and reads nothing (`sortBy(items(), 'name')` in the reference); a call of anything else is a method of a value the template holds, and gives what it is called on and what it is handed.
